violations.text: Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Dumplings were placed warm in the walk-in cooler in a deep, covered container. Dumplings were steamed late morning and temperature observed at 59 degrees F, in proper cooling time and temperature. Dumplings were uncovered and spread out to complete cooling properly. Proper cooling reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients/spices observed not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler condenser fan guards have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Fan guards must be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026

Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the condenser fan guards in the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Fan guards must be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 10/24/2025

Ambient temperature of the prep unit lowboy was observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods in this unit observed with temperatures 43 - 44 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. TCS foods were moved to properly functioning units. Service call placed during inspection. No TCS foods are to be stored in this unit until it is serviced and maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2024
Refrigerator door gasket of the slide cold hold unit observed in poor repair, split away from the door. Gasket is to be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2024
